title: 電気回路Ⅳ(電気工学)
subtitle: Electric Circuits IV for Electrical Engineering
educationalGoal: (1)Students will learn how to calculate the electric circuit of three-phase electricity. (2)Students will learn Fourier series of periodic wave. (3)Students will learn how to calculate the electric circuit with distorted wave.
advice: We will cover the following materials: 1.Three phase electricity 6.1 Generation and characteristics of the three phase electricity, A-1 Symbolic representation of the symmetric three-phase electricity 6.2 Connection of the three phase electricity, A-2 Phase and line voltage of star connection, A-3 Star-star connection, A-5 Delta-delta connection 6.3 Three-phase electric power flow and power vector diagram A-6 Impedance conversion between star and delta connection 2. Distorted wave 3.1 Fourier series 3.2 Fourier series of the distorted wave with specific characteristics 3.3 Average and effective value of the distorted wave 3.4 Power calculation of the distorted wave 3.5 Circuit analysis of the distorted wave
books: Textbooks: none Reference books:none Reserved books:none
requiredKnowledge: Fully understanding of “Electric Circuit I, II, III”. Basic knowledge and application ability of mathematics such as complex number, calculus and trigonometric function.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the basic concept of the three phase electricity and analyze the circuit.
Be able to calculate the equivalent conversion between the delta and star connection.
Be able to understand the Fourier series of the distorted wave.
Be able to calculate the Fourier series of the distorted wave.
Be able to analyze the circuit with the distorted wave.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the concept of the three-phase electricity precisely by mathematical expressions and perform the advanced circuit calculation. (2) Calculate the equivalent impedance conversion between delta and star connection. (3) Correctly calculate the current, voltage, and power of three-phase electricity. (4) Derive the Fourier series formula by yourself and explain the meaning of the formula strictly. (5) Calculate Fourier series of periodic waveform. (6) Correctly calculate the distorted wave current, voltage and power of electric circuit.
achievementLevels.standard: Achieve the 5 items of action goal.
